title: Relax In Space
description:
Start in a virtual art gallery. Look at planets, stars, black holes, and bizarre art, all designed for you to zone out, vibe to your own music, and question reality without ever pressing a “Start Game” button. Visuals that get weirder the longer you stare. It’s a universe that doesn’t need you to win just to let go. 

Other details

- 4K Graphics

- HD Audio

- Virtual Art Museum

- Replicas of the Sun, Earth, Moon, and Jupiter can be found

- Different star types, blue, red, orange

- Different black holes

- And more 

Ambient music will be included but can be turned off if you want to listen to your own music. 

Relax In Space was inspired by films like Interstellar, The Martian, GRAVITY, and more. Relax In Space provides you with the ability to travel and experience new worlds from the comfort of your home. 

Some parts of this game include flashing lights! If you have a sensitivity to lights or flashing lights please be aware! 

Get up close and personal with ultra high detailed planets like Earth 

------------------------------------
description_short: This digital experience doesn’t ask you for much, it just wants you to come as you are. Bring your favorite edibles, mushrooms, music, and Relax. Consider using it for meditation and reflection. A title perfect for those nights when you want to float off into space and forget about things.
